ssp_dynamic.note: Controlled strong time-varying thermocline for concept validation; not claimed as SWARM-95 measured SSP.

reference_profile.note: Controlled strong-thermocline profile for dynamic-basis concept validation; not the frozen 5 m/s benchmark SSP and not claimed as measured SWARM-95 data.

forward_bottom.note: Used only by the controlled oracle/forward root solver. Never supplied to Proposed or local-mode recovery.

estimation.note: Dynamic-aware adapter keeps the frozen Top-N -> continuous refinement -> data-only gate logic, while building coarse/gate dictionaries from the current SSP.

tracking.note: High-SNR tracking pressure isolates basis/decomposition effects from severe measurement noise.

coupling.note: Known unitary two-mode mixing is an imposed truth signal for testing whether dynamic basis tracking preserves genuine modal-energy exchange.
